title: Filipino Peanut Butter Wrap
description: A twist on the classic peanut butter wrap, this Filipino-inspired recipe adds a sweet and savory flavor combination.

ingredients.name: Filipino-style banana catsup
ingredients.notes: or substitute with sweet chili sauce

instructions: Spread 1 tablespoon of peanut butter evenly onto the wrap.
Add 1 tablespoon of Filipino-style banana catsup on top of the peanut butter.
Slice a ripe banana and place on top of the catsup.
Sprinkle a pinch of powdered sugar over the banana.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
